title: Letterhead · Sub-program
slide_intent: Identify a local sender within the larger program. The recipient needs to distinguish the sub-program that wrote the letter from the program that authorizes it.
strategic_value: The program mark and a separate local name can connect local activity to Special Olympics while directing replies to the correct address.
demonstration: The example aligns Blackrock County at the upper left with the logotype baseline on the right. A magnified detail and a footer callout explain what identifies the sub-program.
practical_value: Set the sub-program name in red 10.5 pt Ubuntu Regular aligned with the body margin. Give one relevant address and retain the accreditation line.

content_islands.name: Numbered guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the identification and address rules at left. Explain the omission of directors and the continued use of accreditation.

content_islands.name: Local letter specimen
content_islands.spec: Use dotted guides between the local name and program mark. Enlarge the Blackrock County line in a circle and mark the local contact block at the foot.
